solution.title: Enterprise Desktop Support Runbook Library for Intune-Managed Windows

products.name: Enterprise Desktop Support Runbook Library for Intune-Managed Windows — Commercial
products.short_description: A Tier-1/Tier-2 runbook library for Intune-managed Windows — OS, hardware, profile, sign-in, and user-facing issues — each a repeatable diagnose-to-resolve path with escalation gates. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Give every technician a repeatable way to own the problem end-to-end

In a managed fleet, desktop issues get bounced between tiers because there's no standard way to triage them. This library gives you a Tier-1/Tier-2 runbook set for Intune-managed Windows — OS, hardware, profile, sign-in, and user-facing issues — each a repeatable, step-by-step diagnostic-to-resolution path with the exact checks, escalation gates, and evidence to collect, so technicians resolve issues consistently and own them end to end.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the support operating model (intake → triage → diagnose → resolve/escalate → document), how it maps to an Intune-managed fleet, and how the runbooks are structured.
  • Requirements Guide — what a technician needs (Intune roles, Graph read access, Remote Help/remote tools, asset context) with how to verify each.
  • Runbook Library — step-by-step runbooks for the common enterprise categories: sign-in/profile, OS/update, hardware/peripheral, app, network reachability, and enrollment/compliance — each with triage tree, checks, resolution, and escalation gate.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — endpoint health/context discovery, per-device state validation, a support-metrics/health report, safe common-fix remediation, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates per runbook, plus Best Practices for consistent triage, evidence capture, and escalation.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every technician resolving desktop issues the same repeatable way and owning them end to end — a runbook library and scripts you keep and reuse across the fleet.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • DESKSUP-Discovery.ps1 — read-only endpoint health and context discovery for Intune-managed Windows
    • DESKSUP-Remediation.ps1 — safe common desktop fixes for Intune-managed Windows (defaults to WhatIf)
    • DESKSUP-Report.ps1 — read-only support-metrics and fleet-health summary for Intune-managed Windows
    • DESKSUP-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/adjust pilot and support target groups (defaults to WhatIf)
    • DESKSUP-Validation.ps1 — read-only per-device state validation for Intune-managed Windows

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
